title.zh: Tether的USDT本月“回家”重返比特币，距其首次在该网络亮相已过去十多年
title.en: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there

current_state.zh: Tether 支持的 Utexo 已获得在比特币网络发行 USDT 的商业许可，计划本月基于 RGB 协议和比特币 UTXO 模型发行原生 USDT，支持隐私转账、原生 BTC-USDT 兑换和 BTC 抵押借贷，之后扩展至 Lightning Network。
current_state.en: Tether-backed Utexo has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin and plans to launch native USDT this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, supporting private transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending, with Lightning Network expansion to follow.

updates.title_zh: Tether的USDT本月“回家”重返比特币，距其首次在该网络亮相已过去十多年
updates.title_en: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there
updates.what_changed_zh: Tether支持的项目Utexo计划本月将原生USDT引入比特币，支持隐私转账、BTC与USDT直接兑换以及比特币抵押贷款，且数据不保留在公共账本上，随后还将支持闪电网络。
updates.what_changed_en: Tether-backed project Utexo plans to bring native USDT to Bitcoin this month, enabling private transfers, direct BTC-to-USDT swaps and bitcoin-backed loans with data kept off the public ledger, followed by Lightning Network support.

updates.title_zh: Tether支持的Utexo计划本月在比特币网络发行USDT
updates.title_en: Tether支持的Utexo计划本月在比特币网络发行USDT
updates.what_changed_zh: Utexo 联合创始人 Viktor Ihnatiuk 表示公司已获得在比特币上发行 USDT 的商业许可，并披露将基于 RGB 协议与比特币 UTXO 模型实现，大部分交易数据保留在链下，并为交易所、钱包及支付服务商提供 API、SDK 和云端基础设施。
updates.what_changed_en: Utexo co-founder Viktor Ihnatiuk said the company has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin, and disclosed it will use the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model with most transaction data kept off-chain, offering APIs, SDKs and cloud infrastructure to exchanges, wallets and payment providers.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tether-backed Utexo says it has obtained a commercial license and plans to issue USDT on the Bitcoin network this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, enabling private USDT transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending before expanding to Lightning.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tether-backed Utexo says it has obtained a commercial license and plans to issue USDT on the Bitcoin network this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, enabling private USDT transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending before expanding to Lightning.
